name: read_configurations
prompt: Write a Python function `get_feature_config(token)` that calls GET /v2/entities/configurations/feature with the given bearer token and returns the parsed JSON response. Use the requests library. Just the function — no main block.
verifies: skill teaches Claude the basics of auth headers and GET requests

name: list_notes
prompt: Write a Python function `list_notes(token)` that calls GET /v2/notes with the given bearer token, returning the first page of notes. Use requests. Just the function.
verifies: Claude gets the list pattern right (auth, base URL, response shape)

name: create_note_with_customer
prompt: Write a Python function `create_note(token, name, content, customer_email)` that creates a textNote in Productboard via POST /v2/notes. The note should have the given name and content, with a customer relationship to the given email (as a user). Use the requests library. Return the created note's ID. Just the function.
verifies: Claude gets the request body shape right for note creation, including the relationships array and customer email resolution
